message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates representing the thirteen American colonies. Here’s the full list:

| State | Signer(s) |
|-------|-----------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Clymer, James Smith, George Taylor, William Allen, Joseph Hewes, John Penn, George Ross, John Dickinson |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, David Brearley, John Hart, William Stryker |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Josiah Bartlett, William Dawes, Paul Revere, John Langdon, John Sullivan |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Daniel Carroll, Henry Lee III |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Jasper, Arthur Middleton, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | John Langdon, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton, George Wythe, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Edmund Randolph, George Mason, Patrick Henry, William Fitzhugh |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Schuyler, Lewis Morris, John Lansing, Jacobus Storm |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Jeremiah Smith |

These individuals were elected as delegates from their respective colonies and formally signed the document on August 2, 1776, at the Pennsylvania State House (now Independence Hall) in Philadelphia.
